domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation. The status field drives all state transitions and guards downstream operations like balance deduction.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT → SUBMITTED: employee submits the request for manager review
SUBMITTED → APPROVED: manager approves the request; balance is deducted
SUBMITTED → REJECTED: manager rejects the request; no balance change
DRAFT → CANCELLED: employee discards a draft; terminal state
SUBMITTED → CANCELLED: employee withdraws a submitted request before decision; terminal state
APPROVED → CANCELLED: employee cancels an already-approved leave; balance is restored

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each policy governs how many days an employee is entitled to, whether manager approval is required, minimum notice periods, and accrual behaviour. Policies are referenced by Balance records and LeaveRequests to enforce business rules.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE: policy is soft-disabled; no new requests can use it

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organisation. Holds employment status, reporting line (managerId), and department. Employment status gates whether the employee can submit leave requests. The managerId defines the approval chain.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE: employee is no longer active (e.g. leave of absence); cannot submit new leave requests
ACTIVE → TERMINATED: employee has left the organisation; terminal state, all pending requests are cancelled
INACTIVE → TERMINATED: inactive employee is terminated

domain_entities.name: Balance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave balance for a specific policy and fiscal year. usedDays is incremented when a leave request is approved; remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays. The status reflects whether the balance has available days.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED: remainingDays reaches 0; no further leave of this type can be taken until next accrual or fiscal year reset
EXHAUSTED → ACTIVE: balance is replenished (accrual or new fiscal year)

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification sent to an employee or manager about leave-related events (request submitted, approved, rejected, cancelled). Used to fulfil the notification requirement of the leave management module.
lifecycle_states: PENDING → SENT: notification has been dispatched to the recipient
SENT → READ: recipient has viewed the notification
SENT → ARCHIVED: notification is archived without being read
READ → ARCHIVED: read notification is archived

business_rules: Days requested for a leave period are calculated as (endDate - startDate) + 1, counting calendar days inclusively. Both startDate and endDate are treated as leave days. This formula applies everywhere the leave duration is consumed: sufficiency checks, balance deduction, balance restoration, and any reporting. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest day-counting appears, not only here]

An employee may only submit a LeaveRequest if their employmentStatus is ACTIVE. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees cannot create or submit leave requests. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest submission appears, not only here]

A LeaveRequest can only be approved if the employee has sufficient remaining balance for the requested leave type and fiscal year. The check compares requestedDays (calculated per the broad day-counting rule) against Balance.remainingDays for the matching policy and fiscal year. If remainingDays < requestedDays, the request must be rejected. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest approval appears, not only here]
